topic: The egg thief that was innocent
script: The dinosaur named egg thief was probably protecting its own eggs. Oviraptor got its name in 1924, after it was found near a nest of eggs. Later, embryos inside similar eggs showed they belonged to its own kind. Its relatives have been found fossilized sitting on their nests, like birds. Some dinosaur eggs took months to hatch. Tiny embryos have even been found still curled up inside fossil eggs. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
